deviation: The draft requires payment within 15 days of receipt of a valid invoice, versus Arcadia's 45-day standard. This is shorter than the 30-day fallback and the playbook's "never accept" floor, so it strains cash flow on a USD 1.1M contract. The draft also omits the cap on late payment interest, though it doesn't add interest.
suggested_text: 6.3 Customer shall pay each undisputed invoice within 45 days of receipt of a valid invoice. Late payment interest shall not exceed 1% per month. Customer may withhold payment of any amount disputed in good faith, shall notify Supplier of the dispute and its grounds, and shall pay any undisputed portion. The Parties shall resolve disputes promptly in good faith.
